newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Schulman raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - A. Schulman raised.

text.p: - McDonald & Co said Tuesday it upgraded A. Schulman Inc to aggressive buy from hold based on an improving fundamental earnings outlook for the first quarter ending in November and other factors.
- Analyst Saul Ludwig said in a report he expects strong first quarter earnings of $0.32 a share versus year-ago $0.23.
- Ludwig issued his report, suggesting a price range of $19-$29, when the stock was at $21. It closed Monday at 20-7/8 and had risen 1-1/4 to 22-1/8.
